blocks.text: NEW YORK — Josh Hokit wore an American flag bandana and sunglasses as he extended his hand toward Ciryl Gane and briefly dropped his outrageous “Incredible Hok” persona. “You’re tougher than I thought,” Hokit said. Gane was tough. And he’s still the champ.
